llm.summary: The skill's files, instructions, and required actions are consistent with an Audible client: it authenticates via a user-driven OAuth flow, stores credentials in ~/.config/audible, and calls the Audible API for search, library, wishlist, and purchases.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (search, browse, manage Audible) matches the included scripts and CLI commands. The scripts use the unofficial 'audible' library and httpx to talk to Audible/Amazon endpoints and operate on a per-user config under ~/.config/audible. No unrelated services, binaries, or credentials are requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md and the Python scripts limit actions to: generating an OAuth login URL, completing the redirect-based auth flow, reading/writing ~/.config/audible/auth.json, and making Audible API calls (search, library, info, buy, wishlist). The flow requires manual user interaction to paste the redirect URL; there are no instructions to read unrelated system files or send credentials to third-party endpoints. Note: SKILL.md references an absolute install path (/opt/homebrew/...), which is an installation-specific path and may not exist on all systems.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec (instruction-only), but the skill includes two Python scripts that are intended to be executed. Dependencies (audible, httpx) are required and will need pip installation by the user; there are no downloads from unknown URLs or archive extraction steps in the skill bundle itself.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requests no environment variables or external credentials. It stores OAuth credentials locally at ~/.config/audible/auth.json (auth.to_file(encryption=False)) and sets file permissions to 600. Storing tokens unencrypted but with restrictive permissions is common for CLI tools, but users should be aware the file contains sensitive tokens.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always:false (no forced inclusion). disable-model-invocation is false (normal). The skill does not attempt to modify other skills or system-wide agent settings; its persistence is limited to creating the config directory and auth/state files under the user's home directory.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to do what it claims: run locally, perform an OAuth device/redirect flow, and call Audible APIs. Before installing, consider: (1) Review the included Python code (provided) — it runs locally and you have the source. (2) The auth file (~/.config/audible/auth.json) is written unencrypted (permission 600) — ensure you are comfortable storing Audible tokens on this machine. (3) You will need to pip-install 'audible' and 'httpx' for the scripts to work. (4) Purchases require an explicit --confirm flag, but confirm with the user before any buy operation; verify your agent/automation settings so buys cannot be triggered without your consent. (5) SKILL.md references an installation path (/opt/homebrew/...) that may not match your environment — update commands to the actual script path. (6) Note the SKILL.md comment mentioning "Ryan's account" — make sure the skill is configured for your account and not preconfigured to use someone else. If you are not comfortable storing tokens or running these scripts, do not install; otherwise this skill is internally coherent and matches its stated purpose.
